description: Welcome to our elegant 4-room apartment (92 m²), ideally located in the heart of Paris at the intersection of the 1st, 2nd and 9th arrondissements of Paris, one of the most sought-after areas of the capital. Between the Grands Boulevards, the Opéra Garnier, the Department Stores, theaters, museums and historic neighborhoods, you will enjoy an exceptional location to discover Paris on foot while enjoying a dynamic, lively and perfectly served environment.The spaceFrom the moment you enter, the apartment captivates with its clean and contemporary atmosphere. Each space has been cleverly optimised to provide a place that is simultaneously attractive, functional and pleasant to live in. With its 92 m² of generously laid-out space, this apartment offers plenty of room and a fluid flow of movement, ideal for enjoying a Parisian stay in complete comfort.**Completely renovated in **August 2026, it is brand new on Airbnb and has been verified by the platform, guaranteeing an optimal level of quality and reliability. For its launch, you can already benefit from an exclusive discount applied directly to the price of your stay, a great opportunity to be among the first to discover this place.Its elegant and contemporary decor has been designed with a resolutely high-end spirit, combining aesthetics and practicality. Every detail has been carefully thought out to offer maximum comfort and functionality, in a chic and welcoming atmosphere. Designed to accommodate families or groups of friends on business trips, this luxurious and modern apartment offers a perfect balance between comfort, relaxation, elegance, functionality and a lift. Just for you,- A comfortable and bright spaceThe property has *three comfortable bedrooms, (14,12,8m2) *a pleasant stay with a meeting table or dining
